header.title: Corporate Heritage & Trade Capacity
header.subtitle: Over a decade of delivering verified steel, alloys, and industrial hardware to the Middle East.

story.headline: Built on Rigorous Material Integrity and Reliability
story.paragraph1: Apex Industrial Supplies was founded with a single objective: to eliminate counterfeit materials and supply bottlenecks in the regional industrial sector.
story.paragraph2: Operating from our central 45,000 m² bonded storage yard in Jebel Ali Free Zone, our inventory provides regional contractors with the agility to meet stringent milestone schedules without offshore mill lead times.

missionVision.mission: To supply the highest grade certified structural and piping commodities with uncompromising transparency and on-time port delivery.
missionVision.vision: To be the preferred supply chain distributor across the Middle East and East Africa for vital infrastructure materials.
missionVision.values: Material Verification — Zero compromise on quality. Integrity — Transparent pricing without hidden port fees. Speed — Continuous 24/7 yard logistics.

Complete heat number traceability stamped on all pieces

faq.question: Do you provide Mill Test Certificates (MTC) with every order?
faq.answer: Yes. Every delivery includes original 3.1 Mill Test Certificates detailing chemical composition, tensile strength, and impact test values.

faq.question: What Incoterms do you support for international shipments?
faq.answer: We regularly execute under Ex-Works (JAFZA), FOB Jebel Ali, CFR, and CIF to all major Middle Eastern, African, and European ports.

faq.question: What is your typical turnaround time for stock materials?
faq.answer: In-stock materials can be inspected and loaded within 24 to 48 hours of purchase order receipt.
